content.title: How much is Rory McIlroy worth? Age, wife, earnings of 2025 Masters champ
content.text: Many in the golf world cheered and breathed a sigh of relief last year when Rory McIlroy won the Masters, finally completing his Grand Slam. Now, he has the chance to do what only three other champions have done: Win back-to-back green jackets.McIlroy finds himself atop the leaderboard as the second round begins Friday, tied with Sam Burns at 5-under.AdvertisementHere's a look at his financial wins as well as some of his personal and career highlights:McIlroy's net worth is estimated to be north of $200 million, but the exact figure fluctuates depending on the source.How much are Rory McIlroy's earnings?McIlroy has won the second highest amount of prize money over the course of his career: $110,196,641 with just over $2.2 million year-to-date. Tiger Woods is ahead of him by about $10.8 million over the course of his career.Last year, Forbes ranked McIlroy as the third highest paid golfer in the world with $84 million in earnings over a 12-month period. This broke down to $39 million on-course and $45 million off-course. The highest paid were Jon Rahm followed by Scottie Scheffler.AdvertisementWhere is Rory McIlroy from?McIlroy was born in Holywood, Northern Ireland, and has homes in Northern Ireland, in Wentworth outside of London, and in Jupiter, FL.Who is Rory McIlroy's wife?McIlroy's wife is Erica Stoll, who was a PGA transport official when they met. April 22 will mark nine years of marriage for the couple.How many children does Rory McIlroy have?McIlroy and Stole share a five-year-old daughter Poppy.FILE - Rory McIlroy poses with his wife, Erica Stoll, and their daughter, Poppy McIlroy, alongside the DP World Tour trophy and the Race to Dubai trophy at the closing of the DP World Tour Championship at Jumeirah Golf Estates in Dubai on Nov. 17, 2024.How old is Rory McIlroy?McIlroy was born on May 4, 1989 making him 36 years old.How many PGA titles has Rory McIlroy won?McIlroy's had 29 PGA Tour wins. In addition to the Masters, some of the highlights include two PGA Championships, the Open Championship, the U.S. Open, the Ryder Cup, and two Players Championships.AdvertisementHe also represented Ireland in the 2020 and 2024 Olympics.FILE - Rory McIlroy putts on the 18th green during round 1 of the men's individual stroke play at the 2020 Olympic Summer Games in Tokyo on July 29, 2021.Where is Rory McIlroy on Masters leaderboard 2026?As of publication, McIlroy is tied for the lead in this year's Masters with Sam Burns at 5 under par.Miguel Legoas is a Deep South Connect Team Reporter for USA Today. Find him on Instagram @miguelegoas and email at mlegoas@gannett.com.This article originally appeared on Augusta Chronicle: Masters 2025 champion Rory McIlroy's net worth, earnings, and more
